'''Spencer''' (Japanese: '''スペンサー''' ''Spencer'') is a character in the Pokémon Adventures manga. He is a resident of [[Vaniville Town]] who works at a second-hand book store.

==History==
==={{MangaArc|X & Y}}===
Spencer debuts in ''[[PS573|Gathering Klefki]]''. He was one of the people who were kidnapped by [[Team Flare]] after attempting to escape from the destruction of Vaniville Town caused by the battle between [[Xerxer|Xerneas]] and {{p|Yveltal}}. Spencer and the other kidnapped Vaniville Town residents were taken to the [[Team Flare Secret HQ]], where they were locked inside jail cells.

When Team Flare began the operation to retrieve the dormant tree form of Xerneas, [[Celosia]] used her {{p|Aegislash}} to mind control the Vaniville townspeople in order to use them for slave labor. The townspeople were taken to {{rt|8|Kalos}}, where they were made to load Xerneas's tree form into a vehicle so that it can be moved to Team Flare's base. Spencer was freed from the mind control when [[Korrina]] battled against Celosia and defeated Aegislash with her {{TP|Korrina|Lucario}}.

Afterward, Spencer and the other Vaniville townspeople were taken to a [[Laverre City]] hospital to recuperate.

==Trivia==
* According to [[Satoshi Yamamoto]], several of the Vaniville Town residents are a reference to the long-running television series, {{wp|Criminal Minds}}. Spencer's design is a reference to the character {{wp|Spencer Reid}}.<ref>[https://twitter.com/satoshi_swalot/status/1012299343255097344 Yamamoto's tweet]<sub>(Japanese)</sub></ref>
